name: PERSONAMEM
description: PERSONAMEM is a benchmark for evaluating large language models on dynamic user profiling and personalized response generation. It features over 180 simulated user-LLM interaction histories with up to 60 multi-turn sessions across 15 real-world personalization tasks, assessing models' ability to track evolving user preferences and generate aligned responses.
reputation: Highlights current LLM limitations in dynamic personalization with state-of-the-art models achieving around 50% accuracy.
notes: Includes a user profile and conversation simulation pipeline to facilitate research on user-aware chatbots.
